class.name: Transform3DSpreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [Transform3D] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [Transform3DSpreener] is used to interpolate a [Transform3D] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_transform_3d]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_transform_3d] is the only correct way to create [Transform3DSpreener]. Any [Transform3DSpreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [Transform3DSpreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
